written: 2026-11-08, shortly after the main run was launched and before any main-stage sample was read. The text was composed before launch; the file landed after launch because the first write attempt was refused.
matched_rule_selection: k = 0 data only (cued_prior, cued_prior2, 64-request test-split probe): smallest |c430 - oss430| with both arms in 10-60%, picked to differ in kind. Pooled k = 0: longest 31.9 vs 33.2; listed_last 16.4 vs 19.1.
primary_sample_set: finished samples only; sensitivity counts unfinished as misses

E1.definition: mean over matched rules, mixes and primary_ks of [gain(oss430, k) - gain(c430, k)], where gain(arm, k) = rate(arm, k) - rate(arm, 0), in percentage points

E2.definition: OLS slope of the Jeffreys-smoothed cell logit on f(k) over all ks, per arm, rule and mix; oss430 - c430, averaged over matched rules and mixes

bootstrap.unit: request within family, all of a request's cells together, paired across arms

decision.e2_veto: if E2 on matched rules has a 95% CI excluding 0 with the opposite sign to E1, verdict becomes inconclusive (estimands disagree)
decision.heterogeneity_flag: if the sign of E1 differs between matched rules or mixes, show the split and do not generalise

largest_role: reported separately; cannot decide the verdict, because its priors differ and it saturates
